rationale: The multi-site, spike-in–controlled blinded fingerprint study is a practical next step and is supported by MISEV guidance and program data, so proceed to experimental testing. Critical pre-study mitigations are required first: validate an orthogonal exogenous intact‑EV spike-in (distinguishable and matrix‑stable), exhaustively rule out spike‑in/capture-driven artifacts with orthogonal negative controls, qualify split‑aliquot cold‑chain/logistics and pilot‑lot yields, and plan downstream in vivo bridging to test translational relevance. Success of the proposal depends on these validations; do not use the fingerprint as a go/no‑go gate for costly bridging studies until they are demonstrated.
